data.cultural_impact: The name Sheida carries a sense of feminine strength, dignity, and nobility. In many Islamic cultures, the name is often given to girls as a sign of regard for their future potential to be esteemed and revered women in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sheida holds spiritual significance in Islam as it mirrors the character of some of the most noble and revered women in Islamic history. These include Prophet Muhammad's wife Aisha, one of the greatest scholars and narrators of Hadith, and Lady Khadija, the first wife of Prophet Muhammad and one of the earliest supporters and believers in his message. By giving a girl the name Sheida, parents wish for her to emulate the qualities of these noble women and strive to be a beacon of light and guidance to those around her.
